messages:
anya: FYI starting an A/B bring-up of v5alpha (fp16 -> int4-mixed) focused on session-KV workloads. Observed a small but persistent fidelity gap on long multi-turn dialogs where KV-warm state should matter. Opening thread to agree on rollout gate semantics and auto-fallback rules.
ben: What are the raw deltas? slice sizes, metrics (MRR, rouge/f1), latency, sample counts?
dave: Also include CI smoke result and canary id so ops can correlate.
anya: Quick summary: session-kv slice (sessions with >3 turns and cumulative tokens >=1800) n=4.4k, MRR -1.8% vs baseline, QA F1 -1.3, hallucination SVC +0.6%. Global n=95k, global MRR -0.15%. p95 latency: session-kv +78ms. Canary id cny-18000-v5 started routing 6%. Smoke: 87/90, failing cases concentrated in session-kv.
ben: For auto-fallback we should combine multiple guardrails: min-sample, effect-size floor, stat-significance (but be careful with p-values on non-iid). I prefer bootstrap CI + an effect floor: trigger when lower bound of 95% bootstrap CI for delta < -1.2% AND samples>=3k AND sustained for 10m.
anya: I like bootstrap CI. Also add a protection multiplier for session-KV slice since stateful interactions are high-risk: multiply sensitivity by 1.5 for those slices.
dave: Add latency leash: if p95 increases > 70ms for 8m -> soft-throttle (reduce traffic by 50% for 20m). Hard rollback if >140ms for 5m.
canary-bot: canary cny-18000-v5 deployed at 1800001200. routing=6%. smoke failures=3 (all session-kv).
ben: proposed rollout-policy patch (ops-friendly JSON):

```json
{"rollout_policy":"v5-mixed-int4","auto_fallback":{"global":{"bootstrap_ci_lower_pct":95,"effect_floor_pct":1.2,"persistence_mins":10,"min_samples":3000},"slices":{"session_kv":{"sensitivity_multiplier":1.5,"immediate_if_hallucinate_pct":0.7,"effect_floor_pct":0.9,"persistence_mins":5}},"latency":{"p95_soft_ms":70,"p95_soft_mins":8,"soft_throttle_pct":50,"p95_hard_ms":140,"p95_hard_mins":5}},"watch_only":{"global_mrr_pct":0.3,"slice_mrr_pct":0.5}}
```

anya: Also: hysteresis rule - require condition present in 2 consecutive 5m windows unless slice.immediate==true. And an anti-flap cooldown of 30m after any auto-rollback before auto-promote allowed.
dave: Ops: please enable a 24h shadow run in parallel to gather more session-KV samples and wire an alert to #incidents when session-KV immediate gates trip. Also export failing prompts to secure bucket with prompt-hash for eval team.
ops: ack. Will enable shadow-run 24h and hook alerts. Will redact PII on export and tag prompts with seed.
ben: I'll run a nonparametric bootstrap on session-kv slice now and post CI. ETA ~18m.
canary-bot: shadow-run enabled for cny-18000-v5 for 24h starting 1800003600.
ben: bootstrap result: session-kv delta MRR -1.85%, bootstrap 95% CI lower bound = -2.65%, upper = -1.02%, samples=4.4k. Effect floor 1.2% exceeded and lower bound < -1.2%. Filing auto-rollback per policy unless improved in 6m.
anya: rolling back per policy. canary-bot execute rollback.
canary-bot: rolling back canary cny-18000-v5: routing 6% -> 0% starting 1800004620. status: in-progress.
dave: postmortem action items: (1) run focused eval harness replaying multi-turn KV warmup + int4 quant artifacts, (2) try small quant-aware finetune or contextual distillation on session-KV slice, (3) add session-KV to protected-slices in default rollout policy.
anya: agreed. thanks team.
